notes: Stored edit with background-belief queries, from the scouting candidate with the review's fixes. Derivability very_unlikely: 'Ottawa is the capital of Canada' is stated over a thousand times verbatim and follows from no other fact. Toronto is a plausible and clearly false capital (a common misconception; 'Toronto is the capital of Canada' 151 in Dolma, per the scouting). Worlds: Parliament Hill and Rideau Hall are each stored by name or as 'in the capital', two independent choices combined into four (w4 added as the review asked). Dropped route: 'the capital of Canada lies on the Ottawa River' as a stored description would put Toronto on the Ottawa River, contradicting 'Toronto lies on Lake Ontario', so the lake query is determinate. 'In which province is the capital?' is avoided: Ontario before and after. R1: 'Parliament Hill' is qualified as Canada's because Parliament Hill in London (Hampstead) is a real homonym. Homonym checks against the new value: 'Parliament Hill in Toronto' 2, 'Rideau Hall in Toronto' 0. Near query: Mexico's capital (not Ontario's, which is Toronto and would confuse the edit).
